t.en: Auto setup: calendar, folder and journal files
t.es: Configuración automática: calendario, carpeta y archivos de diario

F.en: The Family folder does not have its three sub-folders. In Files > On My iPhone, make sure the folder Family exists, then check that each Save File action points to Family and has the right Destination Path. Run the test again.
F.es: The Family folder does not have its three sub-folders. In Files > On My iPhone, make sure the folder Family exists, then check that each Save File action points to Family and has the right Destination Path. Run the test again.

M.en: The on-device model did not answer. Turn on Apple Intelligence in iPhone Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri, wait until it has downloaded, then run the test again.
M.es: The on-device model did not answer. Turn on Apple Intelligence in iPhone Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri, wait until it has downloaded, then run the test again.

x.en: The check text did not come back. Make sure the last actions of the block are Copy to Clipboard, then Open URLs, and the shortcut is named exactly Family. Run the test again.

t.es: Comprobar archivos del diario y calendario

x.en: Nothing came back. Run Setup again so the files Letters.txt and Shared.txt exist, then run this check again.
x.es: No volvió nada. Ejecuta de nuevo la configuración para que existan Letters.txt y Shared.txt y repite la comprobación de nuevo.
